evidence.title: Free DESIGN.md generator for AI coding agents | Sokosumi

name: DESIGN.md Generator
summary: Free tool that reads a website URL and writes a DESIGN.md with its colours, typography, spacing and components.
description: Sokosumi's browser-based generator: paste a public website URL, it opens the page in a remote browser and reads its computed styles, then writes a DESIGN.md mixing machine-readable tokens (colours, typography, spacing, shapes, components) with human-readable guidance for AI coding agents. The output can be edited, copied or downloaded and dropped into a repo for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Copilot; the page shows 1,613 saved analyses.
